region.name: The Ashen Crown
region.description: A bleak frontier where old stone roads still cut through soot and cinder.

locations.name: Ashen Gate
locations.description: A cracked iron gate hanging between broken towers, staring over a dead road.

locations.name: Hollow Market
locations.description: Stalls without merchants, lanterns without flame, and the echo of old bargaining.

locations.name: Old Shrine
locations.description: A roofless shrine with a black altar and fresh soot on the floor.

locations.name: Charred Watchtower
locations.description: A leaning watchtower with a bell that rings when the wind changes.

locations.name: Mourning Fields
locations.description: A field of ash where pale grass grows around old burial stones.

locations.name: Blackroot Hollow
locations.description: A low ravine choked with black roots and the smell of wet iron.

locations.name: Drowned Chapel
locations.description: A half-sunken chapel whose bell chamber disappears beneath dark water.

locations.name: Sootbound Crossing
locations.description: A ruined road crossing where caravan tracks vanish into the cinder.

npcs.name: Mira
npcs.title: Scout
memory: Keeps watch on the shrine road.

npcs.name: Bram
npcs.title: Gatekeeper
memory: Counts every traveler who passes the gate.

npcs.name: Ilyra
npcs.title: Bell Keeper
memory: Listens for bells beneath the water.

npcs.name: Tovin
npcs.title: Grave Tender
memory: Marks graves that the ash has not swallowed.

quests.title: Quiet the Old Shrine
quests.description: The wardens want the shrine cleared of whatever woke there.

quests.title: Roots for the Market
quests.description: Kes wants a fresh blackroot cutting from the hollow before the roots rot.

quests.title: The Drowned Bell
quests.description: Ilyra asks you to recover the bell clapper from the drowned chapel.

encounters.description: A bent thing of ash and hunger tears at the altar steps.
Something with bark-hard limbs stalks between the roots.
A waterlogged shape rises from the nave, dragging a chain of prayer beads.

atmospheres.text: Wind slips through the broken towers, carrying the smell of cold iron.
A shutter moves by itself. Somewhere behind the empty stalls, coins clink once.
Ash gathers in the altar's cracks. Whatever stirred here has not forgotten the road.
The watchtower bell gives a single dull knock, though no hand touches it.
Pale grass bends around old stones, exposing scraps of names beneath the ash.
Black roots shift under the soil with a sound like distant breathing.
Water laps against the chapel steps. Far below, something answers with a bell note.
Old wheel tracks divide at the crossing, then vanish where the ash has been disturbed.
